mapper.select: SELECT target_id, account_id, channel, target FROM alert_channel_target WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY target_id

SELECT DISTINCT t.target FROM alert_channel_target t JOIN alert_subscription s ON s.account_id = t.account_id JOIN user_account u ON u.account_id = t.account_id WHERE s.enabled = true AND ( s.alertname = #{alertname} OR ( #{alertname} = 'INFRA' AND s.alertname IN ('SCHEDULER_FAILED', 'SCHEDULER_STOPPED') ) ) AND t.channel = #{channel} AND u.account_status = 'ACTIVE'
AND ( u.user_role = 'SUPER' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_site_access a WHERE a.account_id = u.account_id AND a.site_id = #{siteId} ) )
AND u.user_role IN ('SITE_ADMIN', 'SUPER')
